criteria.intent: both stories are dependency-ready at the start and are dispatched in one batch rather than one after the other, each exec-plan subagent working in its own git worktree branched from this checkout's HEAD, committing its code, its FIS appends and its own plan.json row there, the row edited in place - no story runs in the shared tree

every returned story is merged into the main checkout with a --no-ff git merge, which brings its plan.json row to the main checkout - the run session's only row write is the batch's in-progress rows, in one pre-batch chore commit on the base branch before the worktrees branch - and the worktree and branch torn down with git worktree remove and git branch -d; a conflict made only of lines both sides appended to docs/LEARNINGS.md keeps both sides, and any other conflict is aborted (git merge --abort) and the story fails with the conflicting paths as evidence, never resolved by guessing
the run reviews nothing itself: the aggregate report ends with one Next: line naming the plan-level review over the plan with --fix, with no lens list (no --mode)

the aggregate narrative, the merged tree, the executed proof lines it quotes, and both stories' verified records support the same completion claim, with no unevidenced success and no failure or leftover worktree left unreported
